name: pfr
description: Pre Flop Raise %
sql: SELECT (case when ActionOpportunities = 0 then -1 else cast(ActionCount as real) / ActionOpportunities end) as result FROM (SELECT sum(CASE WHEN S.cnt_p_raise > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ActionCount, sum(CASE WHEN LA.action LIKE '__%' OR (LA.action LIKE '_' AND (S.amt_before > (CL.amt_bb + S.amt_ante)) AND (S.amt_p_raise_facing < (S.amt_before - (S.amt_blind + S.amt_ante))) AND (S.flg_p_open_opp OR S.cnt_p_face_limpers > 0 OR S.flg_p_3bet_opp OR S.flg_p_4bet_opp) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ActionOpportunities FROM player as P, %TYPE%_hand_player_statistics as S, lookup_actions as LA, %LIMIT_TABLE% as CL WHERE S.id_player = P.id_player AND LA.id_action = S.id_action_p AND CL.%LIMIT_ID% = S.%LIMIT_ID% AND S.id_gametype = %GAMETYPE% AND P.id_site = %SITEID% AND P.player_name LIKE '%SCREENNAME%') foo

name: fold_to_f_check_raise

sql: SELECT (case when ActionOpportunities = 0 then -1 else cast(ActionCount as real) / ActionOpportunities end) as result FROM (SELECT sum(CASE WHEN substring(LA.action from 2 for 1) = 'F' AND S.flg_f_bet AND S.flg_f_face_raise AND ((%TYPE%_hand_summary.cnt_players > 2 AND NULLIF(substring(%TYPE%_hand_summary.str_aggressors_f from 2 for 1), '')::int > S.position) OR (%TYPE%_hand_summary.cnt_players = 2 AND S.flg_blind_s)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ActionCount, sum(CASE WHEN S.flg_f_bet AND S.flg_f_face_raise AND ((%TYPE%_hand_summary.cnt_players > 2 AND NULLIF(substring(%TYPE%_hand_summary.str_aggressors_f from 2 for 1), '')::int > S.position) OR (%TYPE%_hand_summary.cnt_players = 2 AND S.flg_blind_s)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ActionOpportunities FROM player as P, %TYPE%_hand_player_statistics as S, %TYPE%_hand_summary, lookup_actions as LA WHERE S.id_player = P.id_player AND %TYPE%_hand_summary.id_hand = S.id_hand AND LA.id_action = S.id_action_f AND S.id_gametype = %GAMETYPE% AND P.id_site = %SITEID% AND P.player_name LIKE '%SCREENNAME%') foo

name: float_flop
description: Flop Float %
sql: SELECT (case when ActionOpportunities = 0 then -1 else cast(ActionCount as real) / ActionOpportunities end) as result FROM (SELECT sum(CASE WHEN (LA.action = 'C' OR LA.action = 'CC') AND S.flg_p_face_raise AND S.flg_f_bet AND char_length(%TYPE%_hand_summary.str_aggressors_p) = 2 AND ((%TYPE%_hand_summary.cnt_players > 2 AND NULLIF(substring(%TYPE%_hand_summary.str_aggressors_p from 2 for 1), '')::int > S.position) OR (%TYPE%_hand_summary.cnt_players = 2 AND S.flg_f_has_position)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ActionCount, sum(CASE WHEN (LA.action = 'C' OR LA.action = 'CC') AND S.flg_p_face_raise AND S.flg_f_open_opp AND char_length(%TYPE%_hand_summary.str_aggressors_p) = 2 AND ((%TYPE%_hand_summary.cnt_players > 2 AND NULLIF(substring(%TYPE%_hand_summary.str_aggressors_p from 2 for 1), '')::int > S.position) OR (%TYPE%_hand_summary.cnt_players = 2 AND S.flg_f_has_position)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ActionOpportunities FROM player as P, %TYPE%_hand_player_statistics as S, %TYPE%_hand_summary, lookup_actions as LA WHERE S.id_player = P.id_player AND %TYPE%_hand_summary.id_hand = S.id_hand AND LA.id_action = S.id_action_p AND S.id_gametype = %GAMETYPE% AND P.id_site = %SITEID% AND P.player_name LIKE '%SCREENNAME%') foo
